verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general configurability: users can swap models, edit the system prompt, set up custom agent workflows and use a multi-user workspace. Nothing documents running multiple distinct agents, each bound to its own prompt, model and workspace, or routing conversations or channels to them. These are adjacent controls, not the multi-agent orchestration capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each
